releaseNotes:
Nokiatis MUC 1.18.2 — the seek bar never lies again, plus real user statistics.

THE SEEK BAR'S LAST HONESTY PASS
• The progress clock no longer jumps backward on every network hiccup: while the song buffers, the bar freezes exactly where it is instead of twitching back, and it only adopts the real position on a genuine seek, a track change or a pause.
• Small backward corrections glide back smoothly instead of snapping, so the time label never visibly ticks in reverse anymore.
• The optimistic seek hold now waits up to 2.5 seconds for the player to truly confirm the scrub (was 1.4) — on a buffering connection the bar stays exactly where your finger left it instead of snapping back to the old position. Still ticks with the same haptics: grab, every 2-second notch, release.

REAL USER STATISTICS — 100% REAL
• The official website now has a Live statistics section: how many people are using Nokiatis MUC right now, how many are offline, and how many have ever used it — plus a per-version breakdown, auto-refreshing every minute.
• The numbers come from the app itself: an anonymous heartbeat sends ONLY a random per-install id, the app version and timestamps. Never your library, history or any personal data — and you can turn it off in Settings → Share anonymous usage statistics.
• Versions before 1.18.2 don't report, so the counters start from this release and grow as everyone updates. Every number on that page is real.

MANDATORY
• This release is mandatory: installs below 31 lock with the full-screen update screen until 1.18.2 is installed. It installs over your current version with the same Team Nokiatis signature — your library, playlists and downloads stay exactly where they are.
